name: target-kind-per-language-go-application
description: A target kind written per language names the Go code an application and the TypeScript code a library, so the Go analysis applies the application's rules: a package nothing imports is reported with its declarations, at possible because no build links it, and carries the published-package note, as published-package-note pins under one kind for the whole target. An analyzer that reads the TypeScript member, or that treats the target as a library because one language is, withholds them.
